title: WaFd, Inc. Announces Cash Dividend of 27 Cents Per Share
summary: SEATTLE, November 10, 2026--Today, the Board of Directors of WaFd, Inc. (Nasdaq: WAFD) (the "Company") announced a regular cash dividend of 27 cents per share.
